scope: Independent source review plus executable tests of production components using narrow engine doubles. No Unity Editor or target device execution.

findings.risk: Restoring a later additive layer after GroundFeedback could overwrite the authored arm pose with a stale GroundFeedback-modified snapshot.
findings.resolution: CharacterAnimation now restores only rotations still owned by its last applied pose. Component comparison preserves even small authoritative changes. Joint production-component test passes both restore/disable orders and repeated frames.

findings.risk: Testing CommitVolley directly did not establish that actual clear/blocked barrels consume the right count or that parallel headings reach real projectile instances.
findings.resolution: Added ShooterIntegrationTests executing complete production Shooter/Spawn/LateUpdate with production Magazine and deterministic physics results. Clear, blocked, partial, reload, cancellation and hit paths pass.

findings.risk: A muzzle obstructed between body and barrel creates no projectile and therefore no material-hit event; this is separate from invalid serialized surface IDs.
findings.resolution: Audio owner informed and documentation distinguishes blocked shots from actual material hits. Shooter suppresses both report and visual recoil on blocked attempts.
